git diff --check && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
checked = 0
for page in Path('docs').rglob('*.md'):
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)', page.read_text()):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        file, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        dest = page.parent / file if file else page
        assert dest.is_file(), (page, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+\s+(.+)$', dest.read_text(), re.M)
            slugs = [re.sub(r'[^\w\s-]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings]
            assert anchor in slugs, (page, target)
        checked += 1
print(f'Checked {checked} local documentation links and anchors.')
